name: crm_record_id
description: Mock CRM record id generated on commit (CRM-XXXXXXXXXX).

name: staged_session_id
description: mock_db's own internal staged-record uuid (stage -> commit correlation).

name: agent_mode
description: 'implicit' or 'guided'. Redundant with which table this row is in, kept for safety if tables are ever unioned.

name: planned_topics
description: Pre-call planned topic labels the rep selected.

name: missing_topics
description: Planned topics that ended up with no recorded outcome at commit time.

fields.name: needs_manual_review
fields.description: Guided flow: true if 3 disposition-confirm attempts failed.

name: correction_count
description: How many times the record was re-staged/corrected before commit.

name: environment
description: e.g. 'local_dev' -- distinguishes demo-local data from future real deployments.
